data_description.api_name: The name of your heating provider's API host. This is visible in the 'API Host' entry of the 'Version' menu in the mobile or web app. If the host name is of the form api-foo.xxxx or api.xxxx, use api-foo or api respectively.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthentication
reauth_confirm.description: The Smartbox integration needs to re-authenticate your account

data.timedelta_update_power: Delta for update power entity (in sec)

data_description.history_consumption: Consumption history recovery mode. Auto: forces the data. Start: initialization. Off: no data recovery (be careful, some values ​​may be aberrant).
data_description.timedelta_update_power: Delta between to attempts to update the power entity for pmo

set_boost_params.name: Set boost parameters
set_boost_params.description: Sets temperature and duration parameters for the boost function.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: The boost switch entity to configure.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: The target temperature to set during boost mode.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: The duration of boost mode in minutes.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Sets (part of) the heater's own weekly schedule. Keys are the days "0".."6" (Monday..Sunday); each value is the list of hourly profile slots (0=frost, 1=eco, 2=comfort). Omitted days keep their current programme.

schedule.name: Schedule
schedule.description: Day-keyed profile slots, e.g. {"0": [0, 0, 1, 1, ...]} with 24 entries per day (48 where the heater supports half-hourly slots).
